recap.headline: Rivermouth Rovers Secure Dramatic 3-2 Comeback Against Ironmere Athletic
recap.summary: Ironmere Athletic took a commanding lead at Estuary Park with first half goals from Emil Quenby and Lars Maraval. Rivermouth Rovers fought back after the break as Ilyas Zevalo and Zane Orbeza turned the game around. Zane Orbeza scored his second goal in the 88th minute to seal a thrilling 3-2 victory for Rivermouth Rovers.
turning_points: 35': Lars Maraval scores to extend Ironmere Athletic lead to 0-2.
60': Ilyas Zevalo scores for Rivermouth Rovers to make it 1-2.
88': Zane Orbeza scores the winning goal for Rivermouth Rovers to make it 3-2.

cards.body: Rivermouth Rovers finished with 56% possession and 2.35 xG, overcoming an early 0-2 deficit caused by Emil Quenby and Lars Maraval. Zane Orbeza netted twice, supported by Ilyas Zevalo and Leon Coldbeck, to secure the 3-2 win.
cards.why_it_matters: The high shot volume of 17 and superior xG of 2.35 ultimately justified the statistical dominance of Rivermouth Rovers.

cards.title: Amazing Comeback Win at Estuary Park
cards.body: Rivermouth Rovers fought hard after being down to win 3-2 against Ironmere Athletic. Zane Orbeza scored the winning goal late in the match to bring great joy to the supporters.
cards.why_it_matters: This thrilling victory shows the wonderful fighting spirit of Rivermouth Rovers until the very end.
